chunk:
/-- **The loop summation lemma** (the generic form of
the enumerator's proved `enumLoop_run`, which is the harvest template;
round-1 audit verdict: Pass, including `N = 0`).
Given round configurations `cfg 0, …, cfg N` of one machine with empty
outputs, such that each round `j < N` within budget `B` either halts with
the verdict `[true]` (when `accept j`) or reaches `cfg (j+1)`, and the
exhaustion round `cfg N` halts with `[false]` within `B`: the run from
`cfg 0` halts within `(N + 1) · B` steps with the single verdict bit
`(List.range N).any accept`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the first accepting round (or `N` when none
accepts), composing the advance segments with
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add` and absorbing halted tails with
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt`; empty round outputs make the final
output exactly the one emitted verdict. -/
theorem loop_run {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x)
    (accept : ℕ → Bool) (B N : ℕ)
    (hout : ∀ j ≤ N, (cfg j).output = [])
    (hend : ∃ t ≤ B, (tm.runFrom (cfg N) t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg N) t).output = [false])
    (hround : ∀ j < N, ∃ t ≤ B,
      if accept j then
        (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).state = none ∧
          (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).output = [true]
      else tm.runFrom (cfg j) t = cfg (j + 1)) :
    ∃ t ≤ (N + 1) * B, (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).output = [(List.range N).any accept] := by
  induction N generalizing cfg accept with
  | zero => simpa using hend
  | succ N ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hc⟩ := hround 0 (by omega)
    have hany : (List.range (N + 1)).any accept =
        (accept 0 || (List.range N).any (fun j => accept (j + 1))) := by
      simp [List.range_succ_eq_map, List.any_map, Function.comp_def]
    by_cases hb : accept 0 = true
    · simp only [hb, ↓reduceIte] at hc
      refine ⟨t, ht.trans ?_, hc.1, ?_⟩
      · exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left B (by omega)
      · simpa [hany, hb] using hc.2
    · simp only [hb] at hc
      -- Shift the round family by one, retaining the same terminal segment.
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hhalt, hout'⟩ := ih
        (fun j => cfg (j + 1)) (fun j => accept (j + 1))
        (fun j hj => hout (j + 1) (by omega)) hend
        (fun j hj => hround (j + 1) (by omega))
      refine ⟨t + s, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Nat.succ_mul]; omega
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc]; exact hhalt
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc]
        simpa [hany, hb] using hout'

end Turing

name: loopHostTM

    FinTM Bool
chunk:
/-- **The loop host**. The decision and find host of the bounded loop: it runs the fuel machine `F`
with its output captured, copies the fuel word `Nat.bits R` into a fixed-width counter, rewinds,
starts `body`, and then alternates captured body rounds from the `anchor` seam with fixed-width
debits of the counter (the first anchor entry is free). An accepting round halts with `[true]`, or
in find mode replays the round's own output; underflow of the counter halts with `[false]`, or with
nothing in find mode. It is the non-forwarding instance `loopHostM body F anchor false findMode` of
the shared controller. -/
abbrev loopHostTM (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (findMode : Bool) :
    FinTM Bool := loopHostM body F anchor false findMode

/-- The fuel states capture all fuel emissions directly in the concrete host. -/

chunk:
/-- **The loop host's configuration contract**. Given a fuel machine for `Nat.bits (R |x|)` within
`T`, an invariant `Inv` that holds at `s0 x` and is preserved by `stepF`, a body startup that
reaches the `anchor` seam of `s0 x` within `T |x|` without visiting the anchor earlier, and body
rounds that, from the seam of an invariant word `s`, take positive time at most `T |x|`, do not
revisit the anchor in between, and either halt with output `out x s` (when `acceptF x s`) or reach
the seam of `stepF x s`: then for every input `x` the host has a family `cfg` of round
configurations with a startup of at most `10·(T |x| + 1)` steps reaching `cfg 0`, empty output at
rounds `0, …, R |x|`, a halted terminal `cfg (R |x| + 1)` with output `[false]` (`[]` in find mode),
and, for each round `i ≤ R |x|`, a segment of at most `10·(T |x| + 1)` steps that halts with output
`[true]` (the round's output in find mode) if orbit point `i` is accepted, and otherwise reaches
`cfg (i + 1)`. The coefficient `10` is today's `loopHost_bound`.

**Proof sketch.** The private `loopHost_contracts`, with coefficient
`loopHost_bound = max 1 (max 9 (3 + 2 + 5)) = 10`, without its two head clauses: the fuel phase and
the body startup give the startup (`loopHost_prepare`, `loopHost_start`); each segment is one
captured body round followed by a debit and rewind of the counter, whose width never exceeds `T |x|`
(`loop_fuel_width`), so every phase costs a constant multiple of `T |x| + 1` (`loopHost_round`); the
last debit underflows into the terminal. -/
theorem loopHostTM_contracts (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (findMode : Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = out x s
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) :
    ∀ x : List Bool,
      ∃ (cfg : ℕ → Cfg (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).k Bool
          (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).State x) (startup : ℕ),
        startup ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1) ∧
        (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
          ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.initCfg x) startup = cfg 0 ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, (cfg i).output = []) ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).state = none ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).output = (if findMode then [] else [false]) ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, ∃ t ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1),
          if acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) then
            ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).state = none ∧
            ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).output =
              (if findMode then out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) else [true])
          else (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t = cfg (i + 1)) := by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨cfg, startup, hs, hinit, hout, hend, hterm, hseg, -, -⟩ :=
    loopHost_contracts body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF out findMode s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep
      hstart hround x
  exact ⟨cfg, startup, hs, hinit, hout, hend, hterm, hseg⟩

discharge a configuration contract: the round-2 audit exhibits a machine
that answers correctly after a deliberate exponential delay, satisfying
the final-answer form while violating every per-round bound). Same
hypotheses as `exists_loopTM`; the conclusion instead exposes, for every
input, the host's **round-configuration family**: a bounded startup
reaching `cfg 0`, empty output at every round configuration, a per-round
accept-or-advance segment within a uniform constant multiple of
`T |x| + 1` — acceptance halting with `[true]`, advance reaching
`cfg (i + 1)` — and the halted `[false]` exhaustion terminal at index
`R |x| + 1`. This is the generic shape of the frozen Chapter-2
`enumMachine_contracts` (`machine-library-design.md` §9c gives the index
and budget translation). The decision form below is a corollary through
an already-halted-terminal summation lemma; the find form shares the
host construction with the payload surfaced, and is not claimed as a
`Turing.loop_run` corollary (round-3 finding R3-1).

**Proof sketch.** The intended host of `exists_loopTM` already *has* this
family: `cfg i` is the host image of the body's seam at the `i`-th orbit
point together with the counter state after `i` debits (initial entry
free), and `cfg (R |x| + 1)` is the halted configuration after the borrow
underflow and the `[false]` emission. Startup is the fuel phase plus the
body startup; each segment is one captured body round plus counter work
bounded **worst-case** by the counter width: the fuel word has length at
most `T |x|` (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.output_length_le` on the fuel machine)
and never grows, so every debit, rewind, and the final

`T |x| + 1` — the per-segment bound needs no amortization (round-3
finding R3-2; the amortized aggregate remains true but is not read off

output `[true]`, the host in decision mode outputs `[true]` if some orbit point
`(stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)` with `i ≤ R |x|` is accepted, and `[false]` otherwise, within
`10·(T n + 1)·(R n + 2)` steps.

**Proof sketch.** The contract family of `loopHostTM_contracts` (output `[true]`): its startup and
at most `R |x| + 1` segments sum, by the already-halted-terminal summation lemma
`loop_halted_run`, to at most `10·(T |x| + 1) + (R |x| + 1)·10·(T |x| + 1)` steps. -/
theorem loopHostTM_decides (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = [true]
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) :
    (loopHostTM body F anchor false).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => [(List.range (R x.length + 1)).any
        fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))])
      (fun n => 10 * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2)) := by

    loopHostTM_contracts body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF (fun _ _ => [true]) false s0 R T hF
      hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround x
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hhalt, houtput⟩ := loop_halted_run E.tm cfg
    (fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))) (10 * (T x.length + 1))
    (R x.length + 1) ⟨hend, by simpa using hout⟩
    (fun j hj => by simpa using hsegments j (by omega))
  exact loop_computes_of_startup E x _ (cfg 0) startup t
    (10 * (T x.length + 1)) (R x.length + 1) hs hinit ht hhalt houtput

/-- **The decision loop combinator** (repaired per
round-1 findings 1, 2, and 4 — see the module docstring). Hypotheses:

* `hF`: the fuel machine writes `Nat.bits (R |x|)` within `T |x|`.
* `hInv0`, `hInvStep`: the admissibility invariant holds at the initial
  state word and is preserved by the step, so every orbit point the
  conclusion mentions is admissible.
* `hstart`: the body reaches the initial seam within `T |x|` without
  visiting the anchor state earlier.
* `hround`: on every **admissible** state word, the body takes **positive**
  time `t ≤ T |x|`, does not re-enter the anchor strictly before `t`, and
  either halts with the verdict `[true]` (acceptance) or sits at the seam
  carrying the stepped word (advance).

Conclusion: one finite machine answers, within a constant multiple of
`(T |x| + 1) · (R |x| + 2)`, whether some orbit point
`(stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)` with `i ≤ R |x|` is accepted.

`c = 10`, which sums the configuration contract through an
already-halted-terminal summation lemma — the frozen `Turing.loop_run`
additionally requires an empty-output terminal, which the exported
`[false]` terminal is not (round-3 finding R3-1) — with startup absorbed
by `ComputesInTime.mono`.

relocated-and-captured to lay `Nat.bits (R |x|)` on a counter tape,
rewinds, and embeds the body via the W1 capture discipline of

captured, never physically emitted until the end). The initial anchor
entry is free; each subsequent entry debits the binary counter in place —
per-segment cost bounded worst-case by the counter width (the proved
estimate below at the borrow lemmas; the amortized aggregate also holds
but is not used per segment), exhaustion exactly at borrow-overflow, so
rounds `0, …, R |x|` run before the exhaustion rejection `[false]`.

already-halted-terminal summation lemma `loop_halted_run` sums the seam
family (the frozen `Turing.loop_run` does not apply to the `[false]`
terminal — fill-audit minor 1's documentation correction, maintainer
closing sweep); the invariant hypotheses confine every round to
admissible words, and positive round duration makes each anchor entry a
genuine round boundary. Phase overheads are absorbed into `c`. -/

and consumers that need to distinguish success from exhaustion use
nonempty payloads (the split search's `pairEncode` outputs are always
nonempty). -/

/-! ### Clean-call phase machinery

Adapted in-file from the proved `e3c*` track/clear and prepared-evaluation
family in `ClassNP/Nondeterminism.lean` (batch A continuation). The original
private declarations are templates only, never dependencies. These phases
preserve the complete tape/head configuration and dispatch at observed
completion; numerical deadlines occur only in the analysis. -/

/-- A zero-tape placeholder supplies only the empty inactive bank of the
virtual-input wrapper. Its own transition is never entered by this phase. -/

name: callTM
header:
def callTM (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k
chunk:
/-- **The clean call**. From the entry seam holding an argument word on tape `0`, it runs `M` on
that argument through tracked banks with `M`'s output captured, clears every bank to its observed
extent, and then either installs the result in place of the argument (`emit = false`) or forwards it
to the physical output and keeps the argument (`emit = true`), erases its administrative storage,
and enters its exit state. -/
def callTM (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := (emCallSource M).k
  State := emCallState M
  tm := {
    q₀ := .inl (.inl (.inr (.inr ((emCallRightTM (emCallTrackTM M)).tm.q₀, true))))
    tr := fun q inp work => match q with
      | .inl q =>
        if q = .inr () then controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inl (0, 0))))
        else ((embedEmitTM (Function.Embedding.refl _) (emCallSource M).tm).tr
          q inp work).mapState Sum.inl
      | .inr (.inl (i, q)) =>
        if hi : i.val < M.k then
          if q = 3 then controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inl (⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩, 0))))
          else ((embedEmitTM (emCallTripleEmbedding M ⟨i.val, hi⟩) emCallClearTM.tm).tr
            q inp work).mapState
            (fun s => .inr (.inl (i, s)))
        else controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inr 0)))
      | .inr (.inr q) => ((embedEmitTM (emCallPairEmbedding M) (emCallFinishTM emit).tm).tr
          q inp work).mapState
          (fun s => .inr (.inr s)) }

  obtain ⟨fuel, ftime, hfh, hfo, hft, hprepare, -⟩ :=
    loopHost_prepare body F anchor true true R T hF x
  obtain ⟨btime, hbt, hbguard, hbend⟩ := hstart x

    refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl rfl rfl ?_
    simp only [candidate, loopCall, captureCfg_output]

/-- **The clean call's run**. If `M` halts on `arg` with output `cap` within `T` steps, then from
the entry seam holding `arg`, over any native input `x`, the clean call first enters its exit state
at a positive time `t ≤ (24 + 13·k_M)·(T + |arg| + |cap| + 1)`, and does not visit it at any earlier
time, including time `0`; at `t` it is at the exit seam holding `cap` with empty output (install
mode), or holding `arg` with output `cap` (emit mode).

**Proof sketch.** `emCall_first` itself: `callEntry` and `callExit` unfold to the states that it
names. Its proof is the completion lemma `emCall_complete` (evaluation through tracked banks,
bank clearing, install or replay, capture erasure and rewinds, within the ledger's coefficient
`6 + 13·k_M + 3·6`) followed by the first-visit cut at the fresh absorbing exit. -/
theorem callTM_run (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime arg cap T) :
    ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (T + arg.length + cap.length + 1),
      0 < t ∧
      (∀ j < t, ((callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M emit) (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) j).state
          ≠ some (callExit M emit)) ∧
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M emit) (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) t =
        { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callExit M emit)
            (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap))
          with output := if emit then cap else [] } :=
  emCall_first M emit x arg cap T hM

/-- **E5a, the install-mode clean call** (spec, added at the emitter-infra
round-1 repair — finding 1's prepared-input/clean-return bridge;
customers: loop and emit-loop bodies calling a catalog transducer on
their tape-resident data, in particular `computesFunInTime_splitSolveWith`'s
evaluator rounds and 3B-cont's token/counter installs). A function-level
contract says nothing about a witness's terminal heads or scratch — a
machine may dirty a tape on its final transition and still compute `f`
within `T` — so the bridge supplies what the function contract cannot:
for any such witness, a **callable module** with designated entry and
exit states whose entry and exit are both the canonical clean seam. From
`Cfg.ofWords entry (stateWord C.k arg)` — the argument as the sole
tape-resident word, every other tape blank, input head at one, empty
output, over an **arbitrary, untouched** native input — the module
reaches, at its first positive visit to `exit`, exactly
`Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (f arg))`: the result installed, all
scratch restored, nothing emitted.

**Construction sketch** (attribution corrected per the emitter-infra
round-3 audit, finding 1). Prepare a virtual input from the
tape-resident argument (the relocated-read discipline of the proved
hosts); run the witness through the capture wrapper over **tracked
banks** — the A-continuation's proved visited-interval/origin-marker
family (`e3cTrackTM`/`e3c_track_run`, `e3cClearTM`/`e3c_clear_run`) —
then sequence the per-triple cleaner over the fixed `M.k` banks: at a
clean entry seam the module's scratch starts blank, so clearing the
tracked interval **is** the restoration, and no overwritten-symbol
history is needed; install the captured result on tape zero (or replay
it, in emit mode); erase the capture; rewind. The history/undo
alternative remains valid independently (round-2 audit, finding 4),
but is not what the delivered continuation proves. Every phase is
charged to `T`, the argument length, or the result length.

The `0 < C.k` clause is load-bearing (emitter-infra round-2 audit,
finding 1): at tape count zero, `stateWord 0 a = stateWord 0 b` for all
`a, b` — the empty-domain degeneracy — and a two-state zero-tape machine
would satisfy the rest of this conclusion for an arbitrary, even
noncomputable, `f`. The positive tape count makes the seam equality
yield `bufferTape (f arg)` at the genuine index zero, so the installed
result is actually extractable by the caller.

**Batch L completion.** `callTM M false` reserves a genuine argument tape,
executes the prepared input through tracked banks, and sequences every
triple cleaner after the observed evaluator return. Since scratch starts
blank, clearing the visited intervals restores the complete clean seam.
`emCall_complete` charges evaluation, bank dispatch/cleanup, result install,
capture erasure, and rewinds within coefficient `24 + 13 * M.k` (the ledger's
`6 + 13 * M.k + 3 * K` with `K = 6`). `emCall_first` cuts at the first visit
to a fresh absorbing exit; no time bound occurs in the transition table. -/

name: phaseHostND
header:
def phaseHostND {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → NDTM k Γ (Ph i))
    (q0 : Σ i, Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) :
    NDTM k Γ (Σ i, Ph i) where
  q₀
chunk:
/-- **The nondeterministic phase host**: `Turing.phaseHostTM` over nondeterministic phases.
Its states are the tagged phase states. A state that `red` maps to `some q` takes one
stationary, silent dispatch step to `q` under either choice; every other state of phase `i`
follows phase `i`'s two transition functions, with successors tagged by `i`. Deterministic
phases enter as `Turing.MultiTapeTM.toNDTM`. (A host of the construction layer; [AB09,
§2.1.2].) -/
def phaseHostND {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → NDTM k Γ (Ph i))
    (q0 : Σ i, Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) :
    NDTM k Γ (Σ i, Ph i) where
  q₀ := q0
  tr := fun b q inp w =>
    match red q.1 q.2 with
    | some q' => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some q'⟩
    | none => ((M q.1).tr b q.2 inp w).mapState (Sigma.mk q.1)

/-- **Each slice of the ND phase host is a deterministic phase host**: fixing the choice `b`
in `Turing.NDTM.phaseHostND` gives `Turing.phaseHostTM` over the phases' slices at `b`.

**Proof sketch.** Compare the two fields. The start states agree (`Turing.NDTM.fixChoice_q₀`,
`Turing.phaseHostTM_q₀`). For the tables, split on the redirect: at a redirected state both
dispatch to its target (`Turing.phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_some`); elsewhere both take the phase's
slice action with the successor tagged (`Turing.phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_none`,
`Turing.NDTM.fixChoice_tr`). A machine is determined by its two fields. -/

name: phaseHostND_fixChoice
header:
theorem phaseHostND_fixChoice {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → NDTM k Γ (Ph i))
    (q0 : Σ i, Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (b : Bool) :
    (phaseHostND M q0 red).fixChoice b = phaseHostTM (fun i => (M i).fixChoice b) q0 red
chunk:
/-- **Each slice of the ND phase host is a deterministic phase host**: fixing the choice `b`
in `Turing.NDTM.phaseHostND` gives `Turing.phaseHostTM` over the phases' slices at `b`.

**Proof sketch.** Compare the two fields. The start states agree (`Turing.NDTM.fixChoice_q₀`,
`Turing.phaseHostTM_q₀`). For the tables, split on the redirect: at a redirected state both
dispatch to its target (`Turing.phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_some`); elsewhere both take the phase's
slice action with the successor tagged (`Turing.phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_none`,
`Turing.NDTM.fixChoice_tr`). A machine is determined by its two fields. -/
theorem phaseHostND_fixChoice {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → NDTM k Γ (Ph i))
    (q0 : Σ i, Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (b : Bool) :
    (phaseHostND M q0 red).fixChoice b = phaseHostTM (fun i => (M i).fixChoice b) q0 red := by
  have hq : ((phaseHostND M q0 red).fixChoice b).q₀ =
      (phaseHostTM (fun i => (M i).fixChoice b) q0 red).q₀ := by
    rw [NDTM.fixChoice_q₀, phaseHostTM_q₀]
    rfl
  have ht : ((phaseHostND M q0 red).fixChoice b).tr =
      (phaseHostTM (fun i => (M i).fixChoice b) q0 red).tr := by
    funext q inp w
    obtain ⟨i, s⟩ := q
    rw [NDTM.fixChoice_tr]
    cases h : red i s with
    | none =>
      rw [phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_none _ _ _ i s h, NDTM.fixChoice_tr]
      simp only [phaseHostND, h]
    | some q' =>
      rw [phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_some _ _ _ i s h]
      simp only [phaseHostND, h]
  calc (phaseHostND M q0 red).fixChoice b
      = ⟨((phaseHostND M q0 red).fixChoice b).q₀, ((phaseHostND M q0 red).fixChoice b).tr⟩ := rfl
    _ = ⟨(phaseHostTM (fun i => (M i).fixChoice b) q0 red).q₀,
          (phaseHostTM (fun i => (M i).fixChoice b) q0 red).tr⟩ := by rw [hq, ht]
    _ = phaseHostTM (fun i => (M i).fixChoice b) q0 red := rfl

/-- **The ND phase lemma** (the nondeterministic counterpart of `Turing.phaseHostTM_run`). Let
phase `i` run under the word `w` from `c` to `c'`, ending at a state `s'` that `red` redirects
to `q'`, and reaching no redirected state before. Then inside the host, every prefix of `w`
drives the tagged phase run from the tagged `c`, and one further choice, either bit, performs
the dispatch to `q'` with every other field of `c'` unchanged.

**Proof sketch.** `Turing.NDTM.runWith_mapState_of_agreeOn` along `Sigma.mk i`, with the good
states those that `red` does not redirect; the final dispatch is one explicit step. -/

theorem phaseHostND_run {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → NDTM k Γ (Ph i))
    (q0 : Σ i, Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (i : I) {x : List Γ}
    (c c' : Cfg k Γ (Ph i) x) (w : List Bool) (h : (M i).runWith w c = c') (s' : Ph i)
    (hs' : c'.state = some s') (q' : Σ i, Ph i) (hred : red i s' = some q')
    (hguard : ∀ u < w.length, ∀ s, ((M i).runWith (w.take u) c).state = some s →
      red i s = none) (b : Bool) :
    (∀ u ≤ w.length, (phaseHostND M q0 red).runWith (w.take u) (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) =
        ((M i).runWith (w.take u) c).mapState (Sigma.mk i)) ∧
      (phaseHostND M q0 red).runWith (w ++ [b]) (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) =
        c'.mapState (fun _ => q')

/-- **The ND phase lemma** (the nondeterministic counterpart of `Turing.phaseHostTM_run`). Let
phase `i` run under the word `w` from `c` to `c'`, ending at a state `s'` that `red` redirects
to `q'`, and reaching no redirected state before. Then inside the host, every prefix of `w`
drives the tagged phase run from the tagged `c`, and one further choice, either bit, performs
the dispatch to `q'` with every other field of `c'` unchanged.

**Proof sketch.** `Turing.NDTM.runWith_mapState_of_agreeOn` along `Sigma.mk i`, with the good
states those that `red` does not redirect; the final dispatch is one explicit step. -/
theorem phaseHostND_run {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → NDTM k Γ (Ph i))
    (q0 : Σ i, Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (i : I) {x : List Γ}
    (c c' : Cfg k Γ (Ph i) x) (w : List Bool) (h : (M i).runWith w c = c') (s' : Ph i)
    (hs' : c'.state = some s') (q' : Σ i, Ph i) (hred : red i s' = some q')
    (hguard : ∀ u < w.length, ∀ s, ((M i).runWith (w.take u) c).state = some s →
      red i s = none) (b : Bool) :
    (∀ u ≤ w.length, (phaseHostND M q0 red).runWith (w.take u) (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) =
        ((M i).runWith (w.take u) c).mapState (Sigma.mk i)) ∧
      (phaseHostND M q0 red).runWith (w ++ [b]) (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) =
        c'.mapState (fun _ => q') := by
  let emb : Ph i ↪ (Σ i, Ph i) := ⟨Sigma.mk i, sigma_mk_injective⟩
  have hagree : ∀ (b : Bool) (s : Ph i), red i s = none → ∀ inp work,
      (phaseHostND M q0 red).tr b (emb s) inp work =
        ((M i).tr b s inp work).mapState emb := by
    intro b s hs inp work
    simp only [phaseHostND, emb, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, hs]
  have hpre : ∀ u ≤ w.length,
      (phaseHostND M q0 red).runWith (w.take u) (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) =
        ((M i).runWith (w.take u) c).mapState (Sigma.mk i) := by
    intro u hu
    exact runWith_mapState_of_agreeOn (M i) (phaseHostND M q0 red) emb
      (fun s => red i s = none) hagree c (w.take u) (by
        intro v hv s hs
        rw [List.length_take] at hv
        rw [List.take_take, Nat.min_eq_left (by omega)] at hs
        exact hguard v (by omega) s hs)
  refine ⟨hpre, ?_⟩
  rw [runWith_append]
  have hw := hpre w.length le_rfl
  rw [List.take_length, h] at hw
  rw [hw, runWith_cons, runWith_nil]
  have hst : (c'.mapState (Sigma.mk i)).state = some ⟨i, s'⟩ := by
    simp [Cfg.mapState, hs']
  unfold stepWith
  rw [hst]
  simp only [phaseHostND, hred]
  apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [Cfg.mapState, hs']

name: guessRunCfg_clean
header:
theorem guessRunCfg_clean {K k : ℕ} {SP SR : Type} {z : List Bool} (ι : Fin K ↪ Fin k)
    (cap : Fin k) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι) (jR : Fin K) (blk : ℤ → Option Bool) (m : ℕ)
    (hblk : ∀ p : ℤ, (p < 0 ∨ (m : ℤ) ≤ p) → blk p = none) (q : SP) (entry : SR)
    (s : List Bool) (hs : s.length = m) :
    guessRunCfg (⟨some q, 1, Function.update (fun _ _ => none) (ι jR) blk, fun _ => 0, []⟩ :
        Cfg k Bool SP z) (ι jR) s entry =
      embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] []
        (streamStartCfg z jR entry s)
chunk:
/-- **The core's precondition at the handoff.** Let the setup end clean: in a state `q`, with
the input head on the first symbol, every tape blank except tape `ι jR`, which holds a block `blk`
blank outside the cells `0, …, m - 1`, every head at `0`, and an empty output. Then, for every
stream `s` of length `m`, the run's entry configuration in state `entry` is the core's start
configuration `Turing.streamStartCfg z jR entry s`, silently embedded along `ι` with the capture
tape `cap` outside the selection (`Turing.embedSilentCfg` with a blank frame, heads at `0`, an
empty capture word and an empty host output). This is the clean-bank, head and output
precondition of `Turing.exists_ndInterpreterCore`, delivered by the guess and the rewind.

**Proof sketch.** Field by field. The state and the input head are `entry` and `1` on both
sides. A selected tape `ι a` is the core's tape `a` (`Turing.embedSilentCfg_selected_tape`): at
`a = jR` the overwritten block is `bufferTape s`, since `blk` is blank outside the block and so is
`bufferTape s`; elsewhere both are blank. The capture tape holds the empty capture word with its
head at `0` (`Turing.embedSilentCfg_cap`); every other unselected tape is the blank frame
(`Turing.embedSilentTM_frame` at time `0`). Heads are `0`; outputs are
empty. -/
theorem guessRunCfg_clean {K k : ℕ} {SP SR : Type} {z : List Bool} (ι : Fin K ↪ Fin k)
    (cap : Fin k) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι) (jR : Fin K) (blk : ℤ → Option Bool) (m : ℕ)
    (hblk : ∀ p : ℤ, (p < 0 ∨ (m : ℤ) ≤ p) → blk p = none) (q : SP) (entry : SR)
    (s : List Bool) (hs : s.length = m) :
    guessRunCfg (⟨some q, 1, Function.update (fun _ _ => none) (ι jR) blk, fun _ => 0, []⟩ :
        Cfg k Bool SP z) (ι jR) s entry =
      embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] []
        (streamStartCfg z jR entry s) := by
  classical
  -- a one-state machine whose frame lemma at time `0` reads the unselected tapes
  let M0 : MultiTapeTM K Bool SR :=
    ⟨entry, fun _ _ _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩⟩
  have hframe := (embedSilentTM_frame ι cap hcap M0 (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] []
    (streamStartCfg z jR entry s) 0).1
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero] at hframe
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ Set.range ι
    · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hi
      rw [embedSilentCfg_selected_tape]
      simp only [guessRunCfg, streamStartCfg]
      by_cases ha : a = jR
      · subst ha
        rw [Function.update_self, if_pos rfl]
        funext p
        simp only [Function.update_self, zero_add, sub_zero, hs]
        by_cases hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p < (m : ℤ)
        · rw [if_pos hp]
        · rw [if_neg hp, hblk p (by omega)]
          simp only [FinTM.bufferTape]
          split_ifs with h0
          · symm
            exact List.getElem?_eq_none (by rw [hs]; omega)
          · rfl
      · have hne : ι a ≠ ι jR := fun h => ha (ι.injective h)
        rw [Function.update_of_ne hne, Function.update_of_ne hne, if_neg ha]
    · by_cases hc : i = cap
      · subst hc
        have hne : i ≠ ι jR := fun h => hi ⟨jR, h.symm⟩
        simp only [guessRunCfg, Function.update_of_ne hne]
        -- the capture tape holds the empty capture word
        rw [(embedSilentCfg_cap ι i hcap (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] []
          (streamStartCfg z jR entry s)).1]
        simp [streamStartCfg]
      · have hne : i ≠ ι jR := fun h => hi ⟨jR, h.symm⟩
        simp only [guessRunCfg, Function.update_of_ne hne]
        exact ((hframe i hi hc).1).symm
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ Set.range ι
    · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hi
      rw [embedSilentCfg_selected_pos]
      rfl
    · by_cases hc : i = cap
      · subst hc
        -- the capture head sits after the empty capture word
        rw [(embedSilentCfg_cap ι i hcap (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] []
          (streamStartCfg z jR entry s)).2]
        simp [guessRunCfg, streamStartCfg]
      · exact ((hframe i hi hc).2).symm
  · rfl

/-- **Guess, then run the interpreter core** (the assembly `Turing.exists_timed_universal_NDTM`'s
sketch names). Let `R` be a `K`-tape machine with an entry state `entry` and live verdicts `acc`
and `rej`, run silently on the host tapes selected by `ι`, its emissions captured on a tape
`cap` outside the selection (`Turing.embedSilentTM`). Let the setup `P` reach its exit `pexit`
first at time `TP`, clean: input head on the first symbol, every tape blank except tape `ι jR`,
which is nonblank exactly at the cells `0, …, m - 1`, every head at `0`, empty output. Suppose
that for every stream `s` of length `m`, `R` from its start configuration
`Turing.streamStartCfg z jR entry s` reaches a verdict first within `T`. Then the host `N` halts
on every branch within `TP + 2m + T + 11`, and at every budget `B` at least that, `N` has a branch
of length exactly `B` halting with output exactly `[true]` iff some stream `s` of length `m`
makes `R`'s first verdict `acc`. `R`'s own output is never examined: the capture makes the host's
output exactly the verdict bit. [AB09, §2.1.2, proof of Theorem 2.6; Exercise 2.6]

**Proof sketch.** The setup's endpoint satisfies the block hypotheses of
`Turing.guessRunTM_runWith_handoff` (nonblank inside the block, blank at `m` and at `-1`). By
`Turing.guessRunCfg_clean` the entry configuration is `R`'s start, silently embedded, so the
run's states are `R`'s and its output stays empty (`Turing.embedSilentTM_runFrom`). Conclude by
`Turing.guessRunTM_haltsWithin` and `Turing.guessRunTM_accepts_iff`, whose output condition then
holds. -/

name: inputFoldTM
chunk:
/-- **R8.5d, the input fold** (design §12.8a). Read the native input left to
right, updating a finite state by `δ` from `a₀`, then walk the input head back
and enter the live anchor `done a` with the final state `a` as the verdict.
No work tape is touched. With `δ` testing membership in the image of an
embedding, it is the input validator of design §12.8a §0. -/
def inputFoldTM {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} (k : ℕ) (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) :
    MultiTapeTM k Γ (ScanPhase A) where
  q₀ := .fwd a₀
  tr := fun q inp _ =>
    match q with
    | .fwd a =>
      match inp with
      | some γ => inputMoveAction 1 (.fwd (δ a γ))
      | none => inputMoveAction (-1) (.bwd a)
    | .bwd a =>
      match inp with
      | some _ => inputMoveAction (-1) (.bwd a)
      | none => inputMoveAction 1 (.done a)
    | .done a => inputMoveAction 0 (.done a)

/-- The native fold's forward accumulator and input position after `r` reads. -/

name: inputFoldTM_run_ofCfg
header:
theorem inputFoldTM_run_ofCfg {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ}
    (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a₀)) (hin : d.inputPos = 1) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d (2 * x.length + 2) =
        { d with state
chunk:
/-- **R8.5d, the input fold, framed** (design §12.8a). From any configuration
in the forward phase at `a₀` with the input head at position `1`, the fold
reaches `done (x.foldl δ a₀)` at exactly `2|x| + 2`, where `x` is the native
input, and no `done` anchor earlier. Nothing else changes: the finish is the
start configuration with only the control state replaced, so the input head is
back at `1`. Up to the exit no work head moves.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the input cells: after `j ≤ |x|` forward steps the
state is the fold of the first `j` symbols and the input head is at `j + 1`.
The right end marker turns the head, `|x|` steps return it, and the left end
marker supplies the entry step. -/
theorem inputFoldTM_run_ofCfg {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ}
    (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a₀)) (hin : d.inputPos = 1) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d (2 * x.length + 2) =
        { d with state := some (.done (x.foldl δ a₀)) } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * x.length + 2, ∀ a,
        ((inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (.done a)) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * x.length + 2 →
        ((inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [scan_fold_trace δ a₀ d hstate hin]
    simp [catalogTrace, show ¬2 * x.length + 2 ≤ x.length by omega]
  · intro t ht a
    rw [scan_fold_trace δ a₀ d hstate hin]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp [scanFoldF, scanFoldR] <;> omega
  · intro j t _
    rw [scan_fold_trace δ a₀ d hstate hin]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp [scanFoldF, scanFoldR]

end Turing

name: phaseHostTM
header:
def phaseHostTM {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type}
    (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i)
    (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) : MultiTapeTM k Γ (Σ i, Ph i) where
  q₀
chunk:
/-- **The phase host** (design §12.8a, record rows; §12.8 fill). Phase `i` runs `M i`. A
state that `red` maps to `some q` takes one stationary, silent dispatch step to `q`; every
other state follows its phase's table. With two phases and one redirect it is the seam
discipline of `Turing.seamCompTM`. -/
def phaseHostTM {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type}
    (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i)
    (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) : MultiTapeTM k Γ (Σ i, Ph i) where
  q₀ := q0
  tr := fun q inp w =>
    match red q.1 q.2 with
    | some q' => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some q'⟩
    | none => ((M q.1).tr q.2 inp w).mapState (Sigma.mk q.1)

/-- **The phase host's table off the redirects**: at a state `s` of phase `i` that `red` does
not redirect, the host takes phase `i`'s action, with the successor state tagged by `i`. -/

name: phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_none
header:
theorem phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_none {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type}
    (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i)
    (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (i : I) (s : Ph i) (hs : red i s = none)
    (inp : Option Γ) (w : Fin k → Option Γ) :
    (phaseHostTM M q0 red).tr ⟨i, s⟩ inp w = ((M i).tr s inp w).mapState (Sigma.mk i)
chunk:
/-- **The phase host's table off the redirects**: at a state `s` of phase `i` that `red` does
not redirect, the host takes phase `i`'s action, with the successor state tagged by `i`. -/
theorem phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_none {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type}
    (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i)
    (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (i : I) (s : Ph i) (hs : red i s = none)
    (inp : Option Γ) (w : Fin k → Option Γ) :
    (phaseHostTM M q0 red).tr ⟨i, s⟩ inp w = ((M i).tr s inp w).mapState (Sigma.mk i) := by
  simp only [phaseHostTM, hs]

/-- **The phase host's start state** is the given `q0`. -/

name: phaseHostTM_q₀
chunk:
/-- **The phase host's start state** is the given `q0`. -/
theorem phaseHostTM_q₀ {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type}
    (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i)
    (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) : (phaseHostTM M q0 red).q₀ = q0 :=
  rfl

/-- **The phase host's table at a redirect**: at a state `s` of phase `i` that `red` redirects to
`q'`, the host takes one silent step to `q'`, moving no head and writing nothing. -/

name: phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_some
chunk:
/-- **The phase host's table at a redirect**: at a state `s` of phase `i` that `red` redirects to
`q'`, the host takes one silent step to `q'`, moving no head and writing nothing. -/
theorem phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_some {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type}
    (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i)
    (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (i : I) (s : Ph i) {q' : Σ i, Ph i}
    (hs : red i s = some q') (inp : Option Γ) (w : Fin k → Option Γ) :
    (phaseHostTM M q0 red).tr ⟨i, s⟩ inp w = ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some q'⟩ := by
  simp only [phaseHostTM, hs]

/-- **The phase lemma for a last phase.** Run phase `i` from `c` for `T` steps, with no
redirect strictly before `T`. Then, up to and including `T`, the host is the phase run with
states tagged by `i`. Unlike `Turing.phaseHostTM_run`, nothing is assumed of the state at `T`:
it may be a live exit that `red` does not redirect, so this serves a host's last phase.

**Proof sketch.** On every state reached before `T` the host's table is the tagged phase table
(`Turing.phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_none`), so the agreement transfer
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_mapState_of_agreeOn` gives the run up to `T`. -/

name: phaseHostTM_run_le
header:
theorem phaseHostTM_run_le {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type}
    (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i)
    (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (i : I) {x : List Γ}
    (c : Cfg k Γ (Ph i) x) (T : ℕ)
    (hguard : ∀ u < T, ∀ s, ((M i).runFrom c u).state = some s → red i s = none) :
    ∀ u ≤ T, (phaseHostTM M q0 red).runFrom (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) u =
        ((M i).runFrom c u).mapState (Sigma.mk i)
chunk:
/-- **The phase lemma for a last phase.** Run phase `i` from `c` for `T` steps, with no
redirect strictly before `T`. Then, up to and including `T`, the host is the phase run with
states tagged by `i`. Unlike `Turing.phaseHostTM_run`, nothing is assumed of the state at `T`:
it may be a live exit that `red` does not redirect, so this serves a host's last phase.

**Proof sketch.** On every state reached before `T` the host's table is the tagged phase table
(`Turing.phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_none`), so the agreement transfer
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_mapState_of_agreeOn` gives the run up to `T`. -/
theorem phaseHostTM_run_le {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type}
    (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i)
    (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (i : I) {x : List Γ}
    (c : Cfg k Γ (Ph i) x) (T : ℕ)
    (hguard : ∀ u < T, ∀ s, ((M i).runFrom c u).state = some s → red i s = none) :
    ∀ u ≤ T, (phaseHostTM M q0 red).runFrom (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) u =
        ((M i).runFrom c u).mapState (Sigma.mk i) := by
  intro u hu
  exact MultiTapeTM.runFrom_mapState_of_agreeOn (M i) (phaseHostTM M q0 red)
    ⟨Sigma.mk i, sigma_mk_injective⟩ (fun s => red i s = none)
    (fun s hs inp work => phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_none M q0 red i s hs inp work)
    c u (fun v hv s hs => hguard v (by omega) s hs)

/-- **The phase lemma** (§12.8 fill). Run phase `i` from `c` for `T` steps to `c'`, ending in
a state that `red` redirects to `q'`, with no redirect earlier. Then, up to `T`, the host is
the phase run with states tagged by `i`; one dispatch step later it is `c'` with only its
control replaced by `q'`.

**Proof sketch.** The prefix up to `T` is `Turing.phaseHostTM_run_le`. The dispatch is one step,
read through `Turing.MultiTapeTM.step_of_some`, the host's table at the redirected exit, and the
field equations of `Turing.Action.apply` and `Turing.Cfg.mapState`. No seam induction is
repeated. -/

name: phaseHostTM_run
header:
theorem phaseHostTM_run {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type}
    (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i)
    (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (i : I) {x : List Γ}
    (c c' : Cfg k Γ (Ph i) x) (T : ℕ) (h : (M i).runFrom c T = c') (s' : Ph i)
    (hs' : c'.state = some s') (q' : Σ i, Ph i) (hred : red i s' = some q')
    (hguard : ∀ u < T, ∀ s, ((M i).runFrom c u).state = some s → red i s = none) :
    (∀ u ≤ T, (phaseHostTM M q0 red).runFrom (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) u =
        ((M i).runFrom c u).mapState (Sigma.mk i)) ∧
      (phaseHostTM M q0 red).runFrom (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) (T + 1) =
        c'.mapState (fun _ => q')
chunk:
/-- **The phase lemma** (§12.8 fill). Run phase `i` from `c` for `T` steps to `c'`, ending in
a state that `red` redirects to `q'`, with no redirect earlier. Then, up to `T`, the host is
the phase run with states tagged by `i`; one dispatch step later it is `c'` with only its
control replaced by `q'`.

**Proof sketch.** The prefix up to `T` is `Turing.phaseHostTM_run_le`. The dispatch is one step,
read through `Turing.MultiTapeTM.step_of_some`, the host's table at the redirected exit, and the
field equations of `Turing.Action.apply` and `Turing.Cfg.mapState`. No seam induction is
repeated. -/
theorem phaseHostTM_run {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type} {I : Type} {Ph : I → Type}
    (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : Σ i, Ph i)
    (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option (Σ i, Ph i)) (i : I) {x : List Γ}
    (c c' : Cfg k Γ (Ph i) x) (T : ℕ) (h : (M i).runFrom c T = c') (s' : Ph i)
    (hs' : c'.state = some s') (q' : Σ i, Ph i) (hred : red i s' = some q')
    (hguard : ∀ u < T, ∀ s, ((M i).runFrom c u).state = some s → red i s = none) :
    (∀ u ≤ T, (phaseHostTM M q0 red).runFrom (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) u =
        ((M i).runFrom c u).mapState (Sigma.mk i)) ∧
      (phaseHostTM M q0 red).runFrom (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) (T + 1) =
        c'.mapState (fun _ => q') := by
  have hpre := phaseHostTM_run_le M q0 red i c T hguard
  refine ⟨hpre, ?_⟩
  rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hpre T le_rfl, h]
  have hst : (c'.mapState (Sigma.mk i)).state = some ⟨i, s'⟩ := by
    rw [Cfg.mapState_state, hs']
    rfl
  have htr : (phaseHostTM M q0 red).tr ⟨i, s'⟩ (c'.mapState (Sigma.mk i)).inputSymbol
      (c'.mapState (Sigma.mk i)).workTapeSymbols = ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some q'⟩ := by
    simp only [phaseHostTM, hred]
  rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hst, htr]
  refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [Action.apply_state, Cfg.mapState_state, hs']
    rfl
  · rw [Action.apply_inputPos, moveInputPos_zero, Cfg.mapState_inputPos, Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
  · funext j q
    rw [Action.apply_workTapes, Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
    show Function.update ((c'.mapState (Sigma.mk i)).workTapes j)
      ((c'.mapState (Sigma.mk i)).workTapePos j)
      ((c'.mapState (Sigma.mk i)).workTapes j ((c'.mapState (Sigma.mk i)).workTapePos j)) q = _
    rw [Function.update_eq_self, Cfg.mapState_workTapes, Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
  · funext j
    rw [Action.apply_workTapePos, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
    exact add_zero _
  · rw [Action.apply_output, Cfg.mapState_output, Cfg.mapState_output]
    exact List.append_nil _


end Turing

name: forwardLoopCfg
header:
def forwardLoopCfg {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (entry : Q)
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) :
    Cfg (k + 2) Bool Q x where
  state
chunk:
/-- **The forwarding round loop's configuration for a source configuration** (H2-F's encoding):
for a `k`-work-tape binary machine `M` with `n + 1` states and a configuration `c` of `M` on the
input `x`, the `(k + 2)`-tape configuration whose input head and mirrored tapes `0, …, k - 1`
(contents and heads) are `c`'s, whose tape `k` holds the table `tableBitsK M.tr` and tape
`k + 1` the blank summary cell followed by the unary current state (empty when `c` is halted),
both auxiliary heads at `0`, whose output is `c`'s output, and whose control is `entry` while
`c` is live and halted once `c` is. It is the step block's seam relation `Turing.StepBlock.Rep`
for `c` with its output erased (so the summary cell is blank), with the physical output
restored: the reset invariant of `Turing.exists_selfUniversal`'s sketch (the H2-S gate's
finding 4). [AB09, §1.4.1, proof of Theorem 1.9] -/
def forwardLoopCfg {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (entry : Q)
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) :
    Cfg (k + 2) Bool Q x where
  state := c.state.map fun _ => entry
  inputPos := c.inputPos
  workTapes := Fin.addCases (motive := fun _ => ℤ → Option Bool) c.workTapes fun j =>
    if j = 0 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr)
    else summaryCells none ((c.state.map unaryFin).getD [])
  workTapePos := Fin.addCases (motive := fun _ => ℤ) c.workTapePos fun _ => 0
  output := c.output

/-! The forwarding configuration's fields as equations, generated by `simps` without the `simp`
attribute: `Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg_state`, `_inputPos`, `_workTapes` (pointwise in the
tape and the cell), `_workTapePos` and `_output`. -/
attribute [simps (config := { isSimp := false }) state inputPos workTapes workTapePos output]
  forwardLoopCfg

/-- Erasing only the simulated output gives the block's reset invariant; the physical
output prefix of the forwarding configuration is retained. -/

name: exists_forwardLoopTM
header:
theorem exists_forwardLoopTM (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q)
      (entry : Q) (C : ℕ),
      ∀ {n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))),
        ∃ cost : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x → ℕ,
          Lockstep M L (forwardLoopCfg entry M) cost {none} {none} ∧
          (∀ c, c.state ≠ none → 0 < cost c ∧
            cost c ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C) ∧
          ∀ (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (t : ℕ), (∀ u < t, (M.runFrom c u).state ≠ none) →
            (∀ i : Fin k, L.visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg entry M c)
                (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆
              M.visitedByTapeHead c t i) ∧
            ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val →
              L.visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg entry M c)
                  (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) j ⊆
                Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C : ℕ) : ℤ))
                  ((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C : ℕ) : ℤ)
chunk:
/-- **H2-F, the forwarding round loop** (host H2's unclocked loop form; `machine-library-design.md`
§14; U2 design note `audits/evidence/u2/U2-design.md` §2.2). For each work-tape count `k` there
is one finite `(k + 2)`-tape binary machine `L`, with an entry state and a constant `C`, such
that for every `k`-work-tape binary machine `M` with `n + 1` states and every input `x`, `L`
simulates `M` step by step through `forwardLoopCfg`: there is a cost function on `M`'s
configurations with
* **a macro-step lockstep** (`Turing.Lockstep`, exits `{none}` on both sides): from the encoding
  of a live configuration `c`, `L` reaches the encoding of `M.step c` after exactly `cost c`
  steps, without halting before; the encoding of a halted configuration is halted. So `L` halts
  exactly when `M` does, with `M`'s output, which it emits step by step
  (`Turing.Lockstep.runFrom`, `Turing.Lockstep.cut`);
* **a per-step bound**: `0 < cost c ≤ 50 · (|tableBitsK M.tr| + 1) + C` for live `c`, a constant
  for a fixed table (the step block's bound plus the leaf's);
* **a space ledger**: over `t` source steps that are live before `t`, each mirrored head visits
  only cells that `M`'s head visits, and the two auxiliary heads stay within
  `50 · (|tableBitsK M.tr| + 1) + C` of their home.

The control of `L` does not depend on `M`, `n` or `x`. [AB09, §1.4.1, proof of Theorem 1.9:
each step of `M` is simulated in a number of steps depending only on `M`'s table]

**Proof sketch.** `L` is the step block `roundTM k` followed, at either of its exits, by a
forwarding leaf on the summary tape: read the summary cell, emit its bit if it holds one, blank
it, then return to the block's entry (exit `entry`) or halt (exit `halt`). For a live `c`, the
block-control part of `forwardLoopCfg entry M c` represents `{c with output := []}` (`Rep`: a blank
summary, the unary state word, both auxiliary heads home), so `roundTM_effect` gives a first exit
after `T ≤ 50 · (|tableBitsK M.tr| + 1)` steps at the representation of
`a.apply {c with output := []}`, silent before, with summary cell
`summaryEmit none a.output = a.output` (`summaryEmit_none`); the exit time is unique
(`roundTM_firstExit_unique`). The leaf emits `a.output`, making the physical output
`(a.apply c).output`, blanks the cell, and enters `entry` or halts according to the exit: the
result is exactly `forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.step c)`. Take `cost c` the block's exit time plus the
leaf's length (at most `C`); the inner times are live by the block's cut and the leaf's. The space
ledger is `roundTM_visited` per round, summed by `MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead_add_subset`; the
leaf moves no head.

**Fill appendix (H2-F).** The two phases are the released block and the forwarding leaf;
`fl_round` proves their composition from the public phase lemma and the block's cut. The
leaf alone emits and clears, and all its heads are stationary. One exit-time witness is chosen
once per live source configuration, together with all its run and visited-set properties.
The cost is that block time plus three for a live successor, or plus two for a halt, so
`C = 3`. `Lockstep.runFrom` supplies iteration; the mirrored ledger uses visited-set addition,
and the auxiliary ledger uses `Lockstep.locate`. -/
theorem exists_forwardLoopTM (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q)
      (entry : Q) (C : ℕ),
      ∀ {n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))),
        ∃ cost : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x → ℕ,
          Lockstep M L (forwardLoopCfg entry M) cost {none} {none} ∧
          (∀ c, c.state ≠ none → 0 < cost c ∧
            cost c ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C) ∧
          ∀ (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (t : ℕ), (∀ u < t, (M.runFrom c u).state ≠ none) →
            (∀ i : Fin k, L.visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg entry M c)
                (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆
              M.visitedByTapeHead c t i) ∧
            ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val →
              L.visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg entry M c)
                  (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) j ⊆
                Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C : ℕ) : ℤ))
                  ((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨(Σ b, fl_Ph k b), inferInstance, inferInstance, fl_TM k, fl_entry k, 3, ?_⟩
  intro n x M
  let cost (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) : ℕ :=
    if h : c.state ≠ none then (fl_step_exists M c h).choose else 1
  have chosen (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (h : c.state ≠ none) :
      cost c = (fl_step_exists M c h).choose := dif_pos h
  have one (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (h : c.state ≠ none) :=
    (fl_step_exists M c h).choose_spec
  have lock : Lockstep M (fl_TM k) (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M) cost {none} {none} := by
    constructor
    · intro c h
      have alive : c.state ≠ none := by simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using h
      rw [chosen c alive]
      exact (one c alive).2.2.1
    · intro c h
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h ⊢
      simp [forwardLoopCfg, h]
    · intro c h u hu
      have alive : c.state ≠ none := by simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using h
      rw [chosen c alive] at hu
      exact (one c alive).2.2.2.1 u hu
  refine ⟨cost, lock, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c h
    rw [chosen c h]
    exact ⟨(one c h).1, (one c h).2.1⟩
  · intro c t ht
    constructor
    · -- Split visited sets at each completed round; the lockstep supplies its start.
      induction t with
      | zero => simp [MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead, forwardLoopCfg]
      | succ t ih =>
        have ht' : ∀ u < t, (M.runFrom c u).state ≠ none := fun u hu => ht u (by omega)
        have alive := ht t (by omega)
        have atRound := lock.runFrom c t ht'
        intro i p hp
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ] at hp
        have split := MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead_add_subset (fl_TM k)
          (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c)
          (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) (cost (M.runFrom c t))
          (Fin.castAdd 2 i) hp
        rcases Finset.mem_union.mp split with before | current
        · have old := ih ht' i before
          exact (Finset.image_subset_image (Finset.range_mono (Nat.le_succ (t + 1)))) old
        · rw [atRound, chosen (M.runFrom c t) alive] at current
          have h := (one (M.runFrom c t) alive).2.2.2.2.1 i current
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp h with rfl | hend
          · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨t, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), rfl⟩
          · have heq := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hend
            apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
            refine ⟨t + 1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), ?_⟩
            simpa only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'] using heq.symm
    · -- Locate an auxiliary-head visit in one round, or at an encoded start.
      intro j hj p hp
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      obtain ⟨u, _, w, hw, run⟩ := lock.locate c t ht v
        (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hv))
      rw [run]
      rcases hw with rfl | ⟨alive, hw⟩
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, fl_home (fl_entry k) M (M.runFrom c u) j hj]
        exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _), Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩
      · rw [chosen (M.runFrom c u) alive] at hw
        exact (one (M.runFrom c u) alive).2.2.2.2.2 j hj
          (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨w, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr hw), rfl⟩)

end StepBlock

end Turing

name: loopTM
header: def loopTM (k : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (k + 2 + 1) Bool (CounterLoopState (Σ key, Ph k key))
chunk:
/-- **The step block's counter loop** (H2's loop form; formerly the private `h1ClockTM` of
`CodeSimulator`): the counter-driven loop host `Turing.counterLoopTM` whose body is the step
block `roundTM k`, whose round anchor is the block's entry `exit k true`, and whose designated
body exit is the block's live halting exit `exit k false`. Its `k + 3` work tapes are the
block's `k + 2` and the binary counter last. It starts with a decrement; each successful
decrement runs one round of the block, that is, one simulated transition; an underflow leaves
through the live anchor `done`, and a simulated halt through the live anchor `escape`. Its
control does not depend on the simulated table. [AB09, §1.4.1, proof of Theorem 1.9; §3.1,
proof of Theorem 3.1: the simulation run for a bounded number of steps] -/
def loopTM (k : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (k + 2 + 1) Bool (CounterLoopState (Σ key, Ph k key)) :=
  counterLoopTM (roundTM k) (exit k true) (some (exit k false))

/-- **The step block's counter loop on a buffered input** (formerly `h1HostedClockTM`): the
loop `loopTM k` hosted by the forwarding virtual-input transformer `Turing.vhostEmitTM` (Z1).
Its `1 + (k + 3)` work tapes are the buffer, which holds the simulated input, and then the
loop's tapes; its control is the loop's paired with Z1's boundary tag; it never moves the native
input head, and it forwards the loop's (empty) emissions. [AB09, §1.4.1] -/

name: hostedLoopTM
header:
def hostedLoopTM (k : ℕ) :
    MultiTapeTM (1 + (k + 2 + 1)) Bool (CounterLoopState (Σ key, Ph k key) × Bool)

def hostedLoopTM (k : ℕ) :
    MultiTapeTM (1 + (k + 2 + 1)) Bool (CounterLoopState (Σ key, Ph k key) × Bool) :=

/-! ## The rounds (internal) -/

/-- The first positive return of the step block to either of its exits (`0` if there is none),
the round index of the loop's proofs (formerly `h1RoundTime`, moved unchanged). It is a proof
index, not a machine that computes a time, and it stays private until MIG-0b's round adapter
(H2 design O7). -/

name: loopTM_run
header:
theorem loopTM_run {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x)
    (live : c.state ≠ none) (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some (exit k true)) (rel : Rep M.tr c d)
    (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → ct (cp + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) = t) :
    ∃ T e ct',
      T ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) + 4 * t + 2 * w.length + 2 ∧
      (∀ t' ≤ t, (M.runFrom c t').state = none →
        T ≤ t' * (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) + 4 * t' + 2 * w.length) ∧
      Rep M.tr (M.runFrom c t) e ∧ e.output = d.output ∧
      (∀ q, ¬(cp ≤ q ∧ q < cp + (w.length : ℤ)) → ct' q = ct q) ∧
      (loopTM k).runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d ct cp) T =
        counterLoopCfg
          (some (if (M.runFrom c t).state.isSome then .done else .escape)) e ct' cp ∧
      ∀ u < T,
        ((loopTM k).runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d ct cp) u).state ≠
          some .done ∧
        ((loopTM k).runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d ct cp) u).state ≠
          some .escape
chunk:
/-- **The step block's counter loop, from any represented live start** (harvested from the
private `h1Clock_effect` of `CodeSimulator` and generalized). Let `M` be a `k`-work-tape binary
machine with `n + 1` states, `c` a live configuration of it on the input `x` (not necessarily
the initial one), and `d` a configuration of the step block at its entry `exit k true` that
represents `c` for `M`'s table (`Rep`). Let the last tape hold a binary counter word `w` of
value `t` (little-endian, possibly padded with high zeros) on the tape contents `ct`, delimited
by blanks at `cp - 1` and `cp + |w|`, with its head at `cp`; write `B = 50·(|tableBitsK M.tr| +
1)`. Started at its first decrement, the loop `loopTM k` reaches, at some time `T`:
* the live exit `done` if `M`'s run from `c` is still live after `t` steps, and the live exit
  `escape` if it has halted by then;
* with its body part `e` representing `M`'s configuration after `t` steps (in the escape case,
  by halting absorption, the configuration in which it halted), the physical output that of `d`,
  the counter head back at `cp`, and the counter tape changed only on `[cp, cp + |w|)`;
* at neither exit at any earlier time;
* with `T ≤ t·B + 4t + 2|w| + 2`, and (**the early-escape bound**) `T ≤ t'·B + 4t' + 2|w|`
  whenever `M`'s run from `c` has halted by some `t' ≤ t`.
The bounds depend on the table only through `|tableBitsK M.tr|`, not on the input, the tape
contents or the start. [AB09, §1.4.1, proof of Theorem 1.9; §3.1, proof of Theorem 3.1]

The private `h1Clock_effect` is the case `c = M.initCfg x`, `w = bits t`,
`ct = FinTM.bufferTape (bits t)`, `cp = 0`, without the early-escape bound and the counter
frame. Not stated: the exact time (the round times of the private round index plus
`Turing.counterOverhead`; no round-time function is public before MIG-0b's round adapter), and
the head trajectories (`Turing.counterLoopTM_run_done` and `Turing.counterLoopTM_run_escape`
state them for the body heads).

**Proof sketch.** As the proof of the former private `h1Clock_effect`, from `c`. The rounds are
indexed by the first positive return of the block to an exit. By induction on the number of
completed source steps, the block's orbit represents the source's run from `c` and keeps the
output (the orbit invariant `loopOrbit_rep`, formerly `h1Clock_orbit`), each live round being
the block's contract `roundTM_effect`, of positive length at most `B`. If the source is live
after `t` steps, the returning loop theorem `Turing.counterLoopTM_run_done` and the uniform round
bound `Turing.counterLoop_time_le` give `done` within `t·B + 4t + 2|w| + 2`. Otherwise let
`u ≤ t` be the first halting time, positive because `c` is live; the escaping theorem
`Turing.counterLoopTM_run_escape` at round `u - 1` gives `escape` at exactly the first `u` round
times plus `Turing.counterOverhead w u`, at most `u·B + 4u + 2|w|` by
`Turing.counterOverhead_le_of_le` (as `u ≤ t`), and every `t'` at which the source has halted is
at least `u`. Halting absorption identifies the represented endpoint; `roundTM_iterate` is the
unclocked analogue of the returning case. -/
theorem loopTM_run {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x)
    (live : c.state ≠ none) (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some (exit k true)) (rel : Rep M.tr c d)
    (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → ct (cp + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) = t) :
    ∃ T e ct',
      T ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) + 4 * t + 2 * w.length + 2 ∧
      (∀ t' ≤ t, (M.runFrom c t').state = none →
        T ≤ t' * (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) + 4 * t' + 2 * w.length) ∧
      Rep M.tr (M.runFrom c t) e ∧ e.output = d.output ∧
      (∀ q, ¬(cp ≤ q ∧ q < cp + (w.length : ℤ)) → ct' q = ct q) ∧
      (loopTM k).runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d ct cp) T =
        counterLoopCfg
          (some (if (M.runFrom c t).state.isSome then .done else .escape)) e ct' cp ∧
      ∀ u < T,
        ((loopTM k).runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d ct cp) u).state ≠
          some .done ∧
        ((loopTM k).runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d ct cp) u).state ≠
          some .escape := by
  by_cases halted : (M.runFrom c t).state = none
  · -- The source halts first at some `u ≤ t`: the loop escapes after round `u - 1`.
    obtain ⟨u, deadline, before, same⟩ := M.exists_first_halt c halted
    have positive : 0 < u := by
      by_contra h
      have zero : u = 0 := by omega
      have bad := congrArg Cfg.state same
      rw [zero, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, halted] at bad
      exact live bad
    let r := u - 1
    have count : r + 1 = u := by dsimp [r]; omega
    have alive (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ r) : (M.runFrom c j).state ≠ none := before j (by omega)
    have round (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ r) :=
      loopOrbit_round M c d entry rel j (fun i hi => alive i (hi.trans hj))
    obtain ⟨lastState, lastRep, lastOutput⟩ := loopOrbit_rep M c live d entry rel u before
    rw [same, halted, Option.isSome_none] at lastState
    rw [same] at lastRep
    let T := (∑ j ∈ Finset.range u,
      loopRoundTime (counterLoopOrbit (roundTM k) loopRoundTime d j)) + counterOverhead w u
    have run := counterLoopTM_run_escape (roundTM k)
      (exit k true) (exit k false) (by simp [exit])
      loopRoundTime d w ct cp hw r (by rw [ht]; omega)
      (fun j hj => ⟨(round j hj).1, (round j hj).2.1, (round j hj).2.2.2⟩)
      (by simpa only [count] using lastState) T (by simp only [T, count])
    have sumBound : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range u,
        loopRoundTime (counterLoopOrbit (roundTM k) loopRoundTime d j)) ≤
        u * (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range u, (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j hj => (round j (by
            have := Finset.mem_range.mp hj; omega)).2.2.1)
        _ = _ := by simp
    have overhead := counterOverhead_le_of_le w u (by rw [ht]; omega)
    refine ⟨T, counterLoopOrbit (roundTM k) loopRoundTime d u,
      (fun q => if cp ≤ q ∧ q < cp + (w.length : ℤ) then
        FinTM.bufferTape (counterWord w u) (q - cp) else ct q),
      ?_, ?_, lastRep, lastOutput, ?_, ?_, run.2.1⟩
    · have bounded := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) deadline
      dsimp [T]
      omega
    · -- The early-escape bound: a halt by `t'` comes no earlier than the first halt `u`.
      intro t' _ halt'
      have early : u ≤ t' := by
        by_contra h
        exact before t' (by omega) halt'
      have bounded := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) early
      dsimp [T]
      omega
    · intro q hq
      simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte]
    · simpa only [loopTM, count, halted, Option.isSome_none, Bool.false_eq_true,
        ↓reduceIte] using run.1
  · -- The source is live after `t` steps: the loop runs `t` rounds and underflows.
    have alive (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ t) : (M.runFrom c j).state ≠ none :=
      M.runFrom_state_ne_none_of_le c t halted j hj
    have round (j : ℕ) (hj : j < t) :=
      loopOrbit_round M c d entry rel j (fun i hi => alive i (by omega))
    let T := (∑ j ∈ Finset.range t,
      loopRoundTime (counterLoopOrbit (roundTM k) loopRoundTime d j)) +
        counterOverhead w (t + 1)
    have run := counterLoopTM_run_done (roundTM k) (exit k true)
      (some (exit k false)) loopRoundTime d w ct cp hw t ht (by
        intro j hj
        obtain ⟨anchor, positive, _, interior⟩ := round j hj
        obtain ⟨next, _, _⟩ := loopOrbit_rep M c live d entry rel (j + 1)
          (fun i hi => alive i (by omega))
        refine ⟨anchor, positive, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro v hv hlt
          obtain ⟨s, hs, ha, he⟩ := interior v hv hlt
          exact ⟨s, hs, ha, fun eq => he (Option.some.inj eq).symm⟩
        · simpa only [Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mpr (alive (j + 1) (by omega))] using next)
      T rfl
    obtain ⟨_, finalRep, finalOutput⟩ := loopOrbit_rep M c live d entry rel t
      (fun j hj => alive j (Nat.le_of_lt hj))
    refine ⟨T, counterLoopOrbit (roundTM k) loopRoundTime d t,
      (fun q => if cp ≤ q ∧ q < cp + (w.length : ℤ) then some true else ct q),
      counterLoop_time_le (roundTM k) loopRoundTime d w t ht
        (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) (fun j hj => (round j hj).2.2.1),
      ?_, finalRep, finalOutput, ?_, ?_, run.2.1⟩
    · intro t' ht' halt'
      exact absurd halt' (alive t' ht')
    · intro q hq
      simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte]
    · simpa only [loopTM, Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mpr halted, ↓reduceIte] using run.1

/-- **The step block's counter loop on a buffered input, from any represented live start**
(harvested from the private `h1HostedClock_effect` and generalized): `loopTM_run` with the loop
hosted by Z1 on the buffered simulated input `x`, over any native input `z` whose head is frozen
at `p`, from any boundary tag `b` valid at the start's input position, and after any prior
physical output `pre`. At the same time `T`, within the same two bounds, the host is at the live
exit `(done, b')` or `(escape, b')`, chosen as in `loopTM_run`, for some arrival tag `b'` valid
at the endpoint's input position, in the transported configuration (`Turing.vhostCfg`) of the
loop's endpoint: the body part `e` represents `M`'s configuration after `t` steps, the output is
`pre` followed by `d`'s, the native head is at `p`, and the counter tape is changed only on
`[cp, cp + |w|)`. At no earlier time is the host at either exit, with either tag.
[AB09, §1.4.1, proof of Theorem 1.9; §3.1, proof of Theorem 3.1]

The private `h1HostedClock_effect` is the case `c = M.initCfg x`, `b = true`, `pre = []`, the
counter `bits t` at `0`, without the early-escape bound and the counter frame. For the
interpreter core `R`, `x` is the copied input window and `c` the replay machine's initial
configuration with the stream on its choice tape.

**Proof sketch.** As the former private `h1HostedClock_effect`'s: apply `loopTM_run`, then the Z1
lockstep `Turing.vhostEmitTM_runFrom` to the whole run, which also gives the arrival tag. Apply
the lockstep again at each strict prefix and project the host control to the loop's, which
transfers the loop's two exit cuts to every tag. The arrival tag is existential, never assumed
to be the initial one. -/

    (live : c.state ≠ none) (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some (exit k true)) (rel : Rep M.tr c d)
    (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ)

    (t : ℕ) (ht : Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) = t)

        vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg
          (some (if (M.runFrom c t).state.isSome then .done else .escape)) e ct' cp) b' p pre ∧
      ∀ u < T, ∀ tag,
        ((hostedLoopTM k).runFrom
            (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d ct cp) b p pre) u).state ≠
          some (.done, tag) ∧
        ((hostedLoopTM k).runFrom
            (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d ct cp) b p pre) u).state ≠
          some (.escape, tag) := by
  obtain ⟨T, e, ct', bound, early, related, output, frame, run, cut⟩ :=
    loopTM_run M c live d entry rel w ct cp hw t ht
  let start := counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d ct cp
  have valid : FinTM.VirtualTag start.inputPos b := by
    change FinTM.VirtualTag d.inputPos b
    rw [rel.1]
    exact hb
  obtain ⟨b', tag, hosted⟩ := vhostEmitTM_runFrom (loopTM k) start b valid p pre T
  rw [run] at tag hosted
  refine ⟨T, e, ct', b', bound, early, related, output, frame, tag, hosted, ?_⟩
  intro u hu tag'
  obtain ⟨b'', _, hostedPrefix⟩ := vhostEmitTM_runFrom (loopTM k) start b valid p pre u
  change ((vhostEmitTM (loopTM k)).runFrom (vhostCfg start b p pre) u).state ≠ _ ∧ _
  rw [hostedPrefix]
  constructor
  all_goals
    intro bad
    have projected := congrArg (Option.map Prod.fst) bad
    simp only [vhostCfg, Option.map_map, Function.comp_def, Option.map_id_fun',
      Option.map_some] at projected
    first
    | exact (cut u hu).1 projected
    | exact (cut u hu).2 projected

/-- **Reading a hosted loop configuration** (the caller's view of the live exits; generalized
from the reading steps of `CodeSimulator`'s `h1HostedVerdict_effect`): in the transported
configuration of a loop configuration with control `q`, counter `ct` at `cp`, and body part `e`
representing a source configuration `c'` of a table `tr`, the host's control is `(q, b)` (live),
its native input head is at `p`, its output is `pre` followed by `e`'s, and the bank cell under
the summary tape's head (`vhostBank (summaryTape k).castSucc`) holds `outputSummary c'.output`:
`some true` exactly when `c'` has emitted exactly `[true]` (`outputSummary_true`). A caller that
redirects the exits of `hostedLoopTM_run` reads its verdict there in one step, as `CodeSimulator`'s
`h1HostedVerdictTM` does.

**Proof sketch.** Control, native head and output are those of `Turing.vhostCfg` over
`Turing.counterLoopCfg` (`Turing.counter_cfg_eq`). The summary tape is a body tape, which the
host keeps on its bank; the seam relation puts its head at cell `0`, which holds the summary. -/

name: hostedLoop_read
header:
theorem hostedLoop_read {k n : ℕ} {x z : List Bool}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c' : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (e : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (rel : Rep tr c' e) (q : CounterLoopState (Σ key, Ph k key)) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool)
    (cp : ℤ) (b : Bool) (p : Fin (z.length + 2)) (pre : List Bool) :
    (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some q) e ct cp) b p pre).state = some (q, b) ∧
      (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some q) e ct cp) b p pre).inputPos = p ∧
      (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some q) e ct cp) b p pre).output = pre ++ e.output ∧
      (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some q) e ct cp) b p pre).workTapeSymbols
        (vhostBank (summaryTape k).castSucc) = outputSummary c'.output
chunk:
/-- **Reading a hosted loop configuration** (the caller's view of the live exits; generalized
